description:
Everything Vulkan: the java.lang.foreign runtime (libshaderc GLSL→SPIR-V
    compile + loader dispatch, no JNI, no native jar), the tensor ComputeBackend, and the
    replay engine — the recorded tape becomes a GLSL compute shader (unrolled forward +
    adjoint, on-device Philox), single precision. The GPU path for machines with no CUDA/HIP
    device; gates at runtime.
